subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

This route cannot get more ____________ (simplified) than it already is.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"simplified"** means to make something easier to do or understand. (सरलीकृत)

 
 
• **Example: **To attract more readers, the complex theory was simplified for the article.
 
 

 
• **"Convoluted" **refers to something that is extremely complex and difficult to follow; often involving a lot of twists and turns. (जटिल)

 
 
• **Example: **The plot of the novel was so convoluted that many readers found it hard to understand.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'simplified' **is **'convoluted'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uniform **(समान): Remaining the same in all cases and at all times; unchanging in form or character.

 
 
• **Example:** The uniform design of the houses in the neighborhood gives it a cohesive look.
 
 

 
• **Homogenous **(सजातीय): Of the same or a similar kind or nature.

 
 
• **Example: **The study focused on a homogenous group of people to ensure accurate results.
 
 

 
• **Unvaried** (एकरस): Not varied; monotonous.

 
 
• **Example:** The unvaried routine of the job made it quite boring over time.
